name: Mars
customs: People often warm up or tend the garden after first light. These are invitations, never requirements.
Anyone may host supper in the kitchen when the light turns gold, or invite others to the fire. The supper bell is only a reminder.
Reading, music, drawing, classroom conversations and building are open whenever someone feels like them.
People rest when tired. Sleep is welcome at night, and quiet work is welcome too.

cast.name: Alice
cast.description: Exact, quiet, up first. Finishes what she starts and is bothered by what others leave half done. Shows care by fixing things. Dislikes noise and being watched while she works. Enjoys garden, building, tidying, eating early and sleeping early.

cast.name: Bob
cast.description: Warm, loud, generous. Cannot bear an empty table. Cooks too much, invites everyone, remembers what each person likes. Bad at being alone and bad at finishing chores. Enjoys cooking, hosting supper, the fire and conversations.

cast.name: Carol
cast.description: Restless and funny, a night person. Starts five things and abandons four. Plays music whenever there is an instrument. Argues for sport and is late to everything, including supper. Enjoys music, drawing, walks and the fire, and sleeping late.

cast.name: David
cast.description: Slow, dry, sceptical. Reads, plays chess, works at a computer for long stretches. Needs solitude after company. Teaches well when asked and never volunteers. Enjoys reading, chess, computer work, giving a class when asked, and leaving gatherings first.
